boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Newberg’s First Street, Hancock Street, Sheridan Street, College Street, River Street and Howard Street corridors, each with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Settle In With the Library Collections
cards.subtitle: Hancock Street corridor · 503 E Hancock St
cards.notes: Enter from Hancock Street to browse the collections or consult library resources; check the city page for current opening times.
cards.short_summary: A civic reading and research stop on Hancock Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The city identifies Newberg Public Library at 503 E Hancock St and states that everyone is welcome to use its resources inside the library.
cards.access_notes: Public library; consult the city FAQ for current hours. Everyone may use resources inside, though some services require a library card.

cards.title: See the Rotating Gallery Exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Sheridan Street corridor · 415 E Sheridan St
cards.notes: Walk the Sheridan Street galleries and note which rotating exhibition is installed; confirm same-day hours before setting out.
cards.short_summary: Free public galleries in Newberg’s cultural district.
cards.evidence_claim: Chehalem Cultural Center says its 5,477 square feet of galleries are free and open to the public and lists its address as 415 E Sheridan St.
cards.access_notes: Galleries are free and open to the public. The center currently lists daily hours, with additional scheduled class and event times.

cards.title: Browse Both New and Used Books
cards.subtitle: First Street corridor · 701 E First St
cards.notes: Browse the new and used shelves along First Street, then ask whether an unavailable title can be ordered for later pickup.
cards.short_summary: An independent bookstore with broad shelves and coffee service.
cards.evidence_claim: Chapters identifies itself as an independent bookstore and coffee shop at 701 E First St selling new and used books across multiple genres.
cards.source_title: About Us — Chapters Books and Coffee
cards.access_notes: Retail bookstore and coffee shop; products and drinks require purchase. Check the business directly for current hours.

cards.title: Check the Week’s Pastry Flavors
cards.subtitle: First Street corridor · 621 E First St
cards.notes: Stop at the First Street storefront and inspect the week’s changing cupcake and pastry selection before choosing a treat.
cards.short_summary: A storefront bakery whose walk-in flavors change weekly.
cards.evidence_claim: Sprinkles of Joy lists its storefront at 621 E First Street and says it serves cupcakes, cookies, coffee cake, scones and other items with flavors changing weekly.
cards.access_notes: The bakery lists Tuesday–Saturday storefront hours; baked goods and beverages require purchase. Verify closures on its homepage.

cards.title: Look Across Several Oregon Art Forms
cards.subtitle: First Street corridor · 604 E First St
cards.notes: Enter from First Street and compare paintings with sculpture, ceramics, glass, fiber, woodwork and other represented media.
cards.short_summary: A downtown gallery focused on work by Oregon artists.
cards.evidence_claim: ART Elements lists its gallery at 604 E First St and says it showcases local Oregon artists; its artist roster spans painting, sculpture, ceramics, glass and other media.
cards.source_title: Visit the Gallery — ART Elements Gallery
cards.access_notes: The gallery lists Tuesday–Saturday public hours and appointments on closed days. Confirm current exhibitions before visiting.

cards.title: Study the Historic Art Deco Marquee
cards.subtitle: First Street corridor · 304 E First St
cards.notes: Pause on First Street to examine the theater’s geometric façade, neon signage and sculptural marquee before a screening.
cards.short_summary: A 1937 downtown cinema with documented Art Deco details.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon’s Historic Sites Database places the Cameo Theatre at 304 E First St, dates it to 1937 and identifies its Art Deco style and original neon signage.
cards.source_title: Cameo Theatre — Oregon Historic Sites Database
cards.access_notes: The exterior can be viewed from First Street. Admission is required for screenings; consult the theater’s official schedule before entering.

cards.title: Trace Herbert Hoover’s Newberg Years
cards.subtitle: River Street corridor · 115 S River St
cards.notes: Book a museum visit from River Street and focus on the rooms interpreting Herbert Hoover’s Oregon childhood and the Minthorn family.
cards.short_summary: A historic-house museum interpreting Hoover’s Newberg childhood.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists its location as 115 S River St and says visitors can learn about Herbert Hoover’s childhood in Oregon with his uncle Dr. John Henry Minthorn.
cards.access_notes: The museum publishes limited afternoon hours and admission prices. Appointments and group tours require advance contact.

cards.title: Take a Short Park Loop
cards.subtitle: Howard Street corridor · 411 S Howard St
cards.notes: Enter from Howard Street for a short path loop, then use the picnic tables or shelter if they are open and unreserved.
cards.short_summary: A city recreation stop with paths and picnic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Chehalem Park and Recreation District lists Memorial Park at 411 S Howard Street with trails or loops, picnic tables, a picnic shelter, play equipment and restrooms.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park access may vary with maintenance, reservations or facility conditions; consult the recreation district before organized use.

cards.title: Pick Up a Bagel or House-Baked Pastry
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor · 107 S College St
cards.notes: Turn onto College Street for a bagel, pastry or locally roasted coffee; verify the day’s operating hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A downtown coffeehouse serving breakfast food and pastries.
cards.evidence_claim: Established local media lists Coffee Cat Coffeehouse at 107 S College St and describes its offerings as bagels, burritos, pastries and locally roasted coffee.
cards.source_title: Newberg Guide to Shopping Local for the Holiday Season
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require purchase. Current operating hours should be confirmed with the coffeehouse before visiting.

cards.title: Browse the Accessories Collection
cards.subtitle: First Street corridor · 602 E First St, Suite B
cards.notes: Step into the First Street shop to compare its apparel, handbags, jewelry and other accessories without assuming current stock.
cards.short_summary: A downtown boutique carrying apparel and accessories.
cards.evidence_claim: Nikki Jane’s official site lists its shop at 602 E 1st St, Suite B and says it carries women’s clothing, necklaces, earrings, scarves and handbags.
cards.access_notes: Retail merchandise requires purchase. The official site lists weekly store hours; check it for changes before heading downtown.
